svg.title: Microsoft: required revenue growth depends on reinvestment
svg.desc: Conditional reverse test using September 24, 2026 price and dated July share count, June financial claims and fiscal-2026 revenue. At a 10% assumed required return, 49% pre-investment cash share and 25% long-run reinvestment, the required ten-year annual revenue growth is 19.64%. It rises to 22.61% at 30% reinvestment. The three lines are alternative required returns, not forecasts or probability bands. See the adjacent table, ownership-price chapter and valuations-data.csv for sources and all assumptions.
